newsitem.title: CHINA: China December 1996 RPI up 4.4 pct yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: China December 1996 RPI up 4.4 pct yr/yr.

text.p: China's retail price inflation for December last year rose by a year-on-year 4.4 percent, the State Statistical Bureau said on Monday.
It gave the figure for the year as 6.1 percent, as previously announced.
That compared with a previously announced retail price inflation rate of 4.6 percent in November.
China's benchmark retail price inflation fell steadily throughout 1996, and Beijing has set a target of 6.0 percent inflation for 1997.
Retail price inflation in Beijing was 6.8 percent, the same as in the poor western province of Ningxia, among the highest rates nationwide. The rate for Shanghai was 3.6 percent.
